messages:
maya: Quick run notes: tried a "windowed speculative" decoder + confidence-anneal on llama3-34b-q4_k_m. Dropping raw canary results here for triage.

jon: cool — top-line perf/quality?

maya: median token latency down ~2.4x vs baseline greedy q4_k_m, p95 down ~1.6x. Throughput(batch=8) ~2.1x. Quality: small drop on MCQ-math (~1.5% abs), TruthfulQA stable. Biggest issues on chained numeric prompts.

li: config? especially the anneal rule and window size.

maya: paste (abridged):

```
model: llama3-34b-q4_k_m
decode:
  mode: windowed-spec
  window: 12
  speculative_ratio: 0.55
  anneal_start: 0.85
  anneal_end: 0.65
  anneal_tokens: 5
  beam: 2
kv_prefill: true
batch: 8
```

maya: anneal decreases acceptance threshold over first few speculative tokens to avoid committing to low-confidence early choices. If anneal fails (confidence below end_conf for >2 tokens) we abort to deterministic beam for remainder.

jon: how measured? datasets and stats?

maya: 1.5k canary each on: MCQ-math (subset), TruthfulQA slice, 5k dialog holdout. Paired bootstrap for significance. math p~0.02. KV churn +3% on long contexts (>2048).

li: remediation ideas?

maya: options: lower speculative_ratio to 0.4, increase anneal_start, or pattern-safety (detect long digit runs -> force deterministic). Plan: run 100k holdouts for these ablations.

infra-bot: deploy.request for job windowed-spec-holdout-6860001111 at 6860001140 by maya

jon: add token-entropy logging at speculative triggers and enable per-example trace for 1k triggers. Also add token-hallucination heuristic metric.

maya: will do. Launching jobs now, ETA ~3.5h. tagging @li @jon for follow-up.
